criteria.notes: Published .wbmap drives the visitor directory, floor and category filters, language selector, layer toggles, and 2D/3D switch; scope matches the approved runtime.
Northline campus geometry, destination hierarchy, directory numbering, and brand mark are preserved from the authored project rather than restyled.
Map-first composition with a restrained directory rail reads as a purpose-built spatial product, not a dashboard template.
Destination names on the extrusions and the directory rows stay legible at 1920x1080 and 1366x768; room-distance floors are met.
Dark preset inverts the chrome with adequate contrast. The floor plate stays light by design because it is authored artwork, not a themed surface.
Directory rows clamp category and status text; the compact list scrolls with a deliberately clipped final row instead of overflowing.
Map holds the dominant area and controls stay bounded. The 2D idle state is intentionally sparse: fills are hidden until selection, leaving labels on the plate.
Brand mark, visitor-information symbol, and floor artwork all resolve from the packaged artifact with no missing-media fallback visible.
The spatial canvas, dual 2D/3D presentation, and semantic map layers remain distinct from the repository dashboard and editorial examples.

screenshots.notes: Full HD 3D idle view renders nonblank and correctly framed. No destination is selected, so no route or detail panel is expected here.
Compact 3D keeps the map usable; the directory scrolls with a partially visible final row as the intended scroll affordance.
Matches the default scenario framing; only the origin-marker pulse phase differs between runs.
Compact scenario preserves the rail structure and readable controls with no overlap or clipped control.
Dark chrome keeps headings, directory rows, status text, and the active view toggle readable against the dark panel.
Flat-map scenario hides extrusions and keeps labels, brand mark, symbol, and origin marker; byte-identical to the previously accepted reference.
